Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Interactive PvP combat frames, reliable held-action scheduling, LB cues, and survival helpers.
Description: A local PvP HUD with fixed Self/S1-S5 combat frames, optional exact row targeting and mouseover, calibrated LB gauges, direct ally LB damage, pressure and CC cues, a bounded held-action scheduler, reactive counter-CC, survival and job helpers, explicit PvP macros, low-MP Focus, assists, team communication, and target highlights.
Changelog: Adds the explicit NIN /panicshu macro for one fail-closed Shukuchi attempt at a frozen terrain point 19.5 yalms along the character's facing. It is manual only: no enemy, pressure, proc, or held-key event can trigger it. Exact Crystalline Conflict is supported directly and Wolves' Den requires the existing testing option. The command never opens the ground cursor or reads, changes, or substitutes a target. It may wait at most 500 ms only for an active Self-Purify claim, cast, native queue, or animation lock, spends its token before the sole native request, and never retries or chooses a shorter point, another action, or a fallback. Own Guard, crowd control, invalid terrain, unavailable Shukuchi, metadata mismatch, and Three Mudra/Doton fail closed. Schema 30 is unchanged.
